purpose: Summative evidence for C2.1 + C2.2 + C2.3.
student_learning_goal: I can write a mystery case using a variable and solve it.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can write a mystery case using a variable and solve it.
header.character_watermark: Detective Dee and Mystery Mo together in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall combined).

parts.student_instructions: Write a real-life mystery case in 1-2 sentences. Pick something from your day.
parts.visual_layout: Top of page. A case description box.

image_placeholders.description: A case description box in B&W line-art, ~7in x 1.5in. Two long lines for sentences. Small drawing area on the right. Header 'Part 1: My Mystery'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P1_CASE: keywords (mystery) name what the box asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Real-life situation with a hidden number.

parts.student_instructions: Translate your case into an equation. Use a variable for the unknown.

image_placeholders.description: A long equation slot in B&W line-art, ~7in x 1in. Header 'Part 2: Equation'. Format: 'My equation: ___'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P2_EQN: keywords (equation) name what the slot asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Equation must include a variable symbol.

parts.student_instructions: Solve the equation. Show your work. CHECK by substituting back.

image_placeholders.description: A solve-and-check box in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2in. Top: 'My answer: ___'. Below: 'My check: ___'. Includes work area. Header 'Part 3: Solve and Check'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P3_SOLVE: keywords (solve) name what the box asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Answer must verify the equation.

parts.student_instructions: Write 1 equivalent expression for your answer. (For example: if your answer is 50, write 50 = 25+25 = 60-10.)

image_placeholders.description: An expression slot in B&W line-art, ~7in x 1in. Header 'Part 4: Equivalent Expression'. Format: '___ = ___'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P4_EQUIV: keywords (equivalent) name what the slot asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Must equal the answer from Part 3.

parts.student_instructions: What does the variable in your case stand for?

image_placeholders.description: A reflection box in B&W line-art, ~7in x 1.5in, with 2 lines. Header 'Part 5: Reflection'. Lines: 'My variable stands for: ___'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P5_REFLECT: keywords (reflection) name what the box asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Should clearly identify what the variable represents.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, swap with a partner and solve each other's mystery cases.
teacher_notes: Lesson 5 capstone summative worksheet. Use as integrated C2.1 + C2.2 + C2.3 evidence. Watch for no-variable cases.
